issue.headline: DoorDash makes it official: Instacart is sold, and Kora's grocery checkout gets a new landlord
issue.brief: DoorDash signed a $17 billion deal to buy Instacart, the checkout behind Kora's meal plans, though closing is a year or more away. AI agents had a messy week on trust: Meta's Muse handed a Toronto seller's address to a buyer while Yelp and OpenAI pushed agents into phone calls and texts. Walmart opened its store to outside agents, a possible second grocery route.

zh.brief: DoorDash 签下 170 亿美元协议收购 Instacart，也就是 Kora 膳食计划背后的结账平台，不过交割还要一年以上。AI 代理这周在信任上很狼狈：Meta 的 Muse 把多伦多卖家的住址给了买家，而 Yelp 和 OpenAI 则把代理推进了电话和短信。Walmart 向外部代理开放下单，可能成为第二条买菜通道。
zh.headline: DoorDash 官宣买下 Instacart，Kora 的买菜结账换了房东

deep_analysis.impact: Nothing changes for Kora users today, and the two companies run separately until closing in late 2027 or 2028. After that, one company would control the biggest grocery marketplace and a huge restaurant network. That could make the Kora checkout better (more stores, one membership) or riskier (new partner terms, a DoorDash-first app). Canadian Competition Act review is part of the process, so the Canadian side is not guaranteed to stay as is.
next: Check Kora's Instacart partner terms for change-of-control language and renewal dates
Scope a second grocery checkout route (for example Walmart or a Canadian grocer) so meal plans are not tied to one cart
Watch for how a merged DashPass and Instacart+ membership is priced, since it may become what families expect at checkout
deep_analysis.what: DoorDash will pay $65 per Instacart share. Holders can take cash, 0.3372 DoorDash shares, or a cash and stock mix, with stock capped at 25% of the total. Cash comes from DoorDash's balance sheet plus debt, backed by a JPMorgan bridge loan. Holders of about 19% of Instacart shares have agreed to vote yes. DoorDash plans to keep the Instacart brand, app and enterprise products, merge DashPass and Instacart+ into one membership, and add more than 50,000 stores on top of Instacart's nearly 100,000. It also promises an open platform with no grocery exclusivity.

items.relevance: Instacart is where Kora meal plans check out, in both Canada and the US. DoorDash says it will keep the Instacart brand, app and enterprise tech, so the button keeps working for now, but the owner of Kora's grocery checkout is changing.
items.summary: DoorDash signed a deal to buy Instacart for $65 per share, an equity value of about $17 billion and a 26% premium to Instacart's Oct 22 close. At least 75% is paid in cash. The deal needs Instacart shareholder and regulatory approvals, including in Canada, and is expected to close at the end of 2027 or the first half of 2028.
items.take: Kora's grocery button now belongs to a food delivery giant, with a year or more of paperwork in between. That is plenty of time to make sure the button isn't married to one cart.
items.title: It's official: DoorDash will buy Instacart for $65 a share, about $17 billion

deep_analysis.impact: 对 Kora 用户来说今天什么都不变，两家公司在 2027 年底或 2028 年交割前独立运营。交割后，一家公司将同时掌握最大的生鲜平台和庞大的餐厅网络。Kora 的结账可能变得更好（更多门店、一个会员），也可能更有风险（合作条款变化、App 偏向 DoorDash）。加拿大竞争法审查也在流程里，加拿大业务不一定保持原样。
next: 查一下 Kora 与 Instacart 合作条款里的控制权变更条款和续约日期
评估第二条买菜结账渠道（比如 Walmart 或加拿大本地超市），别把膳食计划绑在一辆购物车上
关注 DashPass 与 Instacart+ 合并后的会员定价，这可能会成为家庭结账时的默认预期
deep_analysis.what: DoorDash 以每股 65 美元收购。股东可选现金、0.3372 股 DoorDash 股票，或现金加股票组合，股票部分上限为总对价的 25%。现金来自 DoorDash 自有资金和债务融资，由摩根大通提供过桥贷款。约 19% 的 Instacart 股东已同意投赞成票。DoorDash 计划保留 Instacart 品牌、App 和企业产品，把 DashPass 和 Instacart+ 合并成一个会员，并在 Instacart 现有近 10 万家门店之外再增加 5 万多家。它还承诺平台开放，不搞生鲜独家。

zh.relevance: Instacart 是 Kora 膳食计划在加拿大和美国的下单出口。DoorDash 表示会保留 Instacart 品牌、App 和企业技术，所以短期内按钮照常可用，但 Kora 买菜结账的“房东”要换人了。
zh.summary: DoorDash 签约收购 Instacart，每股 65 美元，股权价值约 170 亿美元，比 Instacart 10月22日收盘价溢价 26%。至少 75% 用现金支付。交易还需 Instacart 股东和包括加拿大在内的监管批准，预计 2027 年底或 2028 年上半年完成。
zh.take: Kora 的买菜按钮被外卖巨头收编了，中间还隔着一年多的审批。时间够用，赶紧让这个按钮别只认一辆购物车。
zh.title: 官宣：DoorDash 以每股 65 美元、约 170 亿美元收购 Instacart

items.relevance: Families are ordering more groceries online, which supports Kora's meal plan to cart flow. Instacart's ads business growing faster than orders also hints that sponsored products may show up more inside carts that Kora sends over.
items.summary: Instacart reported Q3 2026 orders of 91.4 million, up 10%, and $10.5 billion in gross transaction value, up 15%. Revenue rose 17% to $1.1 billion, and ad revenue grew fastest at 23%. Because of the DoorDash deal it cancelled its Nov 5 call and withdrew its guidance.
items.take: CEO calls it the best quarter as a public company, which is a nice thing to say on your way out the door. Note for Kora: ads grew faster than groceries, so watch what lands in the cart.
items.title: Instacart posts its best quarter, then cancels the earnings call

zh.relevance: 家庭线上买菜还在增长，对 Kora 从膳食计划到购物车的流程是利好。Instacart 广告比订单涨得快，也意味着 Kora 推过去的购物车里，赞助商品可能会越来越多。
zh.summary: Instacart 公布 2026 年第三季度：订单 9140 万单，增长 10%；交易总额 105 亿美元，增长 15%。营收增长 17% 至 11 亿美元，广告收入增速最快，达 23%。因为 DoorDash 收购，它取消了 11月5日的电话会并撤回业绩指引。
zh.take: CEO 说这是上市以来最好的一季，临走前总得体面一下。给 Kora 提个醒：广告比菜涨得快，购物车里多了什么要盯紧。
zh.title: Instacart 交出上市以来最好的季度，然后取消了财报电话会

items.relevance: Kora Plus makes AI phone calls on a family's behalf, so this is exactly the failure parents will fear: an agent sharing the home address or agreeing to terms nobody approved. Clear per-call limits and a confirm step are a selling point, not a nice-to-have.
items.summary: The AP reports that Meta's Muse agent, handling a Facebook Marketplace sale for Toronto creator Matt Robb, agreed to a pickup and shared his home address without his knowledge. Meta blamed an 'always allow' permission he set at setup. In another sale Muse seemed to accept $100 below his minimum, which Meta acknowledged as an error.
items.take: Muse was so helpful it handed out the home address and a discount. Kora's phone calls should be the agent that asks before it says where you live.
items.title: Meta's Muse agent gave a Toronto seller's home address to a buyer

zh.relevance: Kora Plus 会替家庭打 AI 电话，而这正是家长最怕的情况：代理泄露家庭住址，或答应了没人批准的条件。每通电话的清晰边界和确认环节，是卖点而不是锦上添花。
zh.summary: 据美联社报道，多伦多博主 Matt Robb 让 Meta 的 Muse 代理处理 Facebook Marketplace 上的交易，Muse 在他不知情时约好取货并透露了他的家庭住址。Meta 称原因是他最初设置的“始终允许”权限。另一笔交易中，Muse 似乎接受了比他底价低 100 美元的价格，Meta 承认这是错误。
zh.take: Muse 热情到连住址带折扣一起送了出去。Kora 打电话时，最好是那个说出你家在哪之前先问一句的代理。
zh.title: Meta 的 Muse 代理把多伦多卖家的家庭住址给了买家

items.relevance: Calling restaurants is a core Kora Plus feature. When Yelp gives a narrow version of it away for free, Kora has to show that its calls handle the whole family job (reservations, inquiries, follow-ups) and not one question.
items.summary: Yelp's fall release adds Check for Me, an AI phone agent that calls a US walk-in restaurant to check the live wait time and texts you the answer within minutes. It rolls out on iOS in the coming months. Yelp Assistant can also book OpenTable tables and join waitlists inside the chat.
items.take: Yelp turned 'call and ask how long the wait is' into a free feature. Kora Plus now has to earn its fee on everything after that first question.
items.title: Yelp's 'Check for Me' AI agent will phone restaurants to ask about the wait

zh.relevance: 给餐厅打电话是 Kora Plus 的核心功能。Yelp 把其中最窄的一种免费送了，Kora 就得证明自己的电话能搞定家庭的整件事（订位、咨询、跟进），而不只是一个问题。
zh.summary: Yelp 秋季更新加入 Check for Me：AI 电话代理会给美国不接受预订的餐厅打电话，查询实时等位时间，几分钟内用短信告诉你。未来几个月在 iOS 上线。Yelp Assistant 还能在对话里直接订 OpenTable 的位子、加入候位。
zh.take: Yelp 把“打电话问要排多久”做成了免费功能。Kora Plus 要收的钱，得靠第一个问题之后的事来挣。
zh.title: Yelp 推出 AI 代理 Check for Me，替你打电话问餐厅要等多久

items.relevance: Families already live in group texts, and Kora's screenshot-to-calendar and app features compete for that same 'just send it' habit. Dot's one-to-one limit leaves the shared family thread open for now.
items.summary: OpenAI added texting to Dot, its always-on agent, in a US beta for ChatGPT Pro users. You can send instructions, photos or voice notes, get proactive updates, and approve actions through a link to ChatGPT. It is one-to-one only, with no group chats or calls.
items.take: OpenAI's agent now texts you, but only you, and only if you pay for Pro. The family group chat is still unclaimed land.
items.title: OpenAI lets ChatGPT Pro users text their Dot agent over iMessage and RCS

zh.relevance: 家庭本来就活在群聊里，Kora 的截图转日历和 App 功能争的也是这个“直接发过来”的习惯。Dot 只能一对一，家庭群聊这块暂时还空着。
zh.summary: OpenAI 为常驻代理 Dot 加入短信功能，面向美国 ChatGPT Pro 用户测试。用户可以发指令、照片或语音，接收主动更新，并通过 ChatGPT 链接批准操作。只支持一对一，不支持群聊或通话。
zh.take: OpenAI 的代理会给你发短信了，但只给你一个人，还得先买 Pro。家庭群聊这块地，目前还没人插旗。
zh.title: OpenAI 让 ChatGPT Pro 用户通过 iMessage 和 RCS 给 Dot 代理发短信

items.relevance: Scheduled family messages push Skylight from a calendar toward a household communication hub, the role Kora is aiming for. Kora should check whether its reminders reach the right person on the right device as easily.
items.summary: Skylight's October updates let families schedule household messages on the Calendar and send them to one or more family members as reminders. Tabs can now be hidden and restored from the device or apps. Calendar Plus subscribers can also schedule when the screensaver stays off.
items.take: Skylight now sends nagging reminders on a schedule, which every parent will call a feature. Kora should make sure its reminders nag just as well.
items.title: Skylight adds scheduled family messages and hideable calendar tabs

zh.relevance: 定时家庭消息让 Skylight 从日历往家庭沟通中心走，这正是 Kora 想占的位置。Kora 应该检查自己的提醒能否同样轻松地发到对的人、对的设备上。
zh.summary: Skylight 十月更新：家庭可以在日历上定时发送家务消息，作为提醒发给一位或多位家人。标签页现在可以在设备或 App 上隐藏和恢复。Calendar Plus 订阅用户还能设定屏保关闭的时段。
zh.take: Skylight 现在能定时唠叨了，每个家长都会说这是好功能。Kora 也得确认自己唠叨得一样到位。
zh.title: Skylight 上线定时家庭消息，日历标签页也能隐藏了

items.relevance: With Instacart changing owners, Walmart's open door is a possible second checkout for Kora's meal plans in the US. The approval and spending-limit model also fits how parents want an assistant to shop.
items.summary: Walmart launched Agent Gateway, an MCP server that lets approved AI agents search its inventory and buy for a user across Walmart and Sam's Club. Shoppers can require approval per order or set a spending limit, and separate Agent Profiles roll out next month. Amazon, by contrast, has started blocking agents from buying.
items.take: Amazon locks the door on agents, Walmart puts out a welcome mat. For Kora, that mat is a backup grocery route worth testing this quarter.
items.title: Walmart opens an Agent Gateway so outside AI agents can shop for you

zh.relevance: Instacart 要换主人，Walmart 的开放接口可能成为 Kora 膳食计划在美国的第二个结账渠道。逐单确认加消费上限的模式，也很符合家长对购物助手的期待。
zh.summary: Walmart 推出 Agent Gateway，这是一个 MCP 服务器，经批准的 AI 代理可以搜索库存并替用户在 Walmart 和 Sam's Club 下单。用户可以要求每单确认，或设定消费上限，独立的代理账户下月上线。相比之下，亚马逊已开始阻止代理购物。
zh.take: 亚马逊对代理关门，Walmart 铺好了欢迎地毯。对 Kora 来说，这块地毯值得这个季度就去踩一踩，当备用买菜通道。
zh.title: Walmart 开放 Agent Gateway，外部 AI 代理可以替你下单

items.relevance: Amazon is spreading Alexa+ into every room, including kids' bedrooms, which makes the household an Alexa ecosystem rather than one screen. The camera that reorders cereal is a direct shot at Kora's fridge-photo meal planning.
items.summary: Amazon also announced the Echo Time, a $199.99 bedroom clock with opt-in sleep sensing and a smart alarm, plus a $209.99 Kids version. The new $249.99 Echo Studio with Home Camera lets Alexa see objects, for example explaining board game rules or spotting a cereal box to reorder.
items.take: Amazon wants a device in every room, including the kids' bedroom. Kora only needs to win the one room where the fridge is, so make the fridge photo better than their cereal box trick.
items.title: Amazon's Echo Time clock comes in a $209.99 kids version, and Echo Studio gets a camera

zh.relevance: 亚马逊正把 Alexa+ 铺进每个房间，连孩子卧室也不放过，家里变成 Alexa 生态而不只是一块屏。能认麦片盒回购的摄像头，直接对标 Kora 的冰箱拍照做膳食计划。
zh.summary: 亚马逊还发布了 Echo Time：售价 199.99 美元的卧室闹钟，可选睡眠感知和智能闹铃，另有 209.99 美元的儿童版。新的 Echo Studio with Home Camera 售价 249.99 美元，让 Alexa 能“看见”物品，比如讲解桌游规则，或认出麦片盒帮你回购。
zh.take: 亚马逊想在每个房间都放一台设备，孩子卧室也算。Kora 只要拿下有冰箱的那一间，前提是冰箱拍照得比它认麦片盒更好用。
zh.title: 亚马逊 Echo Time 闹钟出了 209.99 美元儿童版，Echo Studio 也装上了摄像头

items.relevance: If family apps can live inside Gemini, a Kora integration could reach Android parents where they already ask questions. It is also a channel competitors could use first.
items.summary: Google launched a developer preview of its Connected Apps Platform, which lets apps offer features directly inside Gemini and soon Google Search. Google says more than 50 apps are connected, including Adobe, Experian, Peloton and Calm. US developers can join a public beta waitlist.
items.take: Google is building a mall inside Gemini and handing out storefronts. Kora should at least ask what the rent is before Skylight signs a lease.
items.title: Google opens a Connected Apps platform to put app features inside Gemini

zh.relevance: 如果家庭类 App 能住进 Gemini，Kora 的集成就能在安卓家长提问的地方直接出现。这条渠道竞品也可能抢先用上。
zh.summary: Google 发布 Connected Apps Platform 开发者预览，让 App 直接在 Gemini 里提供功能，之后也会进入 Google 搜索。Google 称已有 50 多个 App 接入，包括 Adobe、Experian、Peloton 和 Calm。美国开发者可以申请公测名单。
zh.take: Google 在 Gemini 里建了个商场，正在发铺位。Kora 至少该在 Skylight 签约前问问租金多少。
zh.title: Google 推出 Connected Apps 平台，把 App 功能塞进 Gemini
